title: Operation fixture verification
description: Whether the libraries produce these outcomes is verified in each library's own .dev/verification.json.

entities.title: The everyday fixtures are well-formed
entities.summary: Every UTV value in the everyday fixtures' arguments and expectations passes the schema, ids are unique, and named rule bundles exist.
criteria: Every UTV value under args and expect passes schema/utv-1.0.schema.json.
Every rule bundle named under rules is a file.

entities.title: The text-form fixtures are well-formed
entities.summary: Every value in the text-form fixtures passes the schema and ids are unique.
criteria: Each fixture's value, and expect.value where present, passes schema/utv-1.0.schema.json.
